newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TWO NEWCOMERS BRING BUCHAREST BOURSE LISTINGS TO 50.
newsitem.headline: TWO NEWCOMERS BRING BUCHAREST BOURSE LISTINGS TO 50.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said the number of its listings rose to 50 on Friday, when two more companies joined in trading on the second tier.
The newcomers are UCMR SA hydro equipment maker, located in the Transylvanian town of Resita and Zimtub SA welded pipes maker in southern Zimnicea, a stock exchange statement said.
Following are details of the two companies:
* Number of shares: 5,420,847; each share has a nomional value of 25,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: the State Ownership Fund has a 70.03 percent stake, private investment funds 20.43 percent and managers 9.45 percent.
* Net profit in 1995: 11.842 billion lei; in 1996: 335.8 million.
* Number of shares: 1,686,027; each share has a nominal value of 25,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: the State Ownership Fund has a 69.99 percent stake, private investment funds 16.8 percent and managers 13.21 percent.
* Net profit in 1995: 1.06 billion lei; in 1996: 2.64 billion.
The Bucharest stock exchange trades eight companies on the first tier. ($=7,285)
